name: sort
alt: Content Sort: the waiting items down the left, newest first, with a working paper chosen; its card on the right shows New research, the Working Paper subtype, Keep and next, Skip for now and Delete.

pins.label: The item the card shows. Pick a row, or move with the up and down arrows
Type: what the item is. Pick one, then its subtype
Keep and next: keeps it and opens the next item. K does the same
Delete: takes it out of the queue. D does the same

name: send
alt: The right side of a campus event's card: Event picked, the A&M subtype picked, and ERC Newsletter only ticked, with the line Skips the Policy Exchange: another unit's campus event.

pins.label: ERC event: anything the ERC hosts or co-hosts
A&M: an event on campus, another unit's
ERC Newsletter only: ticked, the item never reaches Publish

name: questions
alt: A card with questions: the Check the link note with Verify link, the Type label in orange with no type picked, and Keep and next greyed with Set a type first under it.

pins.label: Verify link: opens the page in a new tab
Type: its label stays orange until one is picked
Keep and next waits, and says what it needs

name: groups
alt: The lower half of Sort's list: a skipped item with its Skipped tag, then the Past group with Dismiss all and five dated items, then the Already live group with Dismiss all.

pins.label: Skipped: an item you parked. It waits under the new ones
Past: events and opportunities whose date or deadline has gone
Already live: links the Policy Exchange already has

name: finalize
alt: Content Sort's Finalize tab: Rewrite 1 description at the top right, an ERC workshop under Needs a rewrite on the left, and its card with the Original text, Edit and Delete.

pins.label: Needs a rewrite: kept items still waiting for their description
Rewrite 1 description: writes the ones still waiting
Original: the text it came with
Edit: write or fix the description by hand
